name: Obsidian CLI
description: Lets the agent work with Obsidian through its official CLI.

display_description.en: Interact with your Obsidian vault using WorkSwarm and the official CLI tools: search notes, follow links, query Bases, and check Sync status and file history. Windows only.
display_description.zh: 用官方命令行操作笔记库：搜索、查链接、查询 Bases、查看同步状态与历史。仅支持 Windows。

default_init_input.en: Have my local changes been synced yet? And how much storage do I have left?
default_init_input.zh: 我本地的更改同步了吗？我还剩多少存储空间？

quick_inputs.en: Have my local changes been synced yet? And how much storage do I have left?
quick_inputs.zh: 我本地的更改同步了吗？我还剩多少存储空间？

quick_inputs.en: List all of my incomplete tasks in my vault.
quick_inputs.zh: 列出我的笔记库中所有未完成的任务。

quick_inputs.en: Can you find this document for me? I believe it is linked in my daily notes.
quick_inputs.zh: 你能帮我找到这份文档吗？我记得它链接在我的每日笔记里。

display_description.en: Runs Obsidian CLI commands and reports failures, timeouts and open dialogs clearly.
display_description.zh: 运行 Obsidian 命令行指令，并明确报告失败、超时和打开的对话框。
